This is wrong:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7be20279-9536-4730-b4f0-2e0ac0c81df0)
You shouldn't be adding width here.
This should be moved a above, so it's together with x.

The group color should be yellow too:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a39ee03-5c54-4d7a-86de-9144fd8d5709)
Also looks like the warning color does not work here for some reason.

Compare with regular property:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f942665f-6d9b-4778-9009-9230cdde6089)

Duplicated from EditorProperty.
It would be nice to remove the duplication (likely by adding a method), but it doesn't need to be done in this PR.
The way the tooltip text is generated is not tied to the editor, so I moved it above and stored it in a variable that both instances use.

diff_hunk:
@@ -92,6 +92,7 @@ enum PropertyHint {
 	PROPERTY_HINT_DICTIONARY_TYPE,
 	PROPERTY_HINT_TOOL_BUTTON,
 	PROPERTY_HINT_ONESHOT, ///< the property will be changed by self after setting, such as AudioStreamPlayer.playing, Particles.emitting.
+	PROPERTY_HINT_GROUP_ENABLE, ///< used to make the property's group checkable. Only use for boolean types.
 	PROPERTY_HINT_NO_NODEPATH, /// < this property will not contain a NodePath, regardless of type (Array, Dictionary, List, etc.). Needed for SceneTreeDock.
body:
```suggestion
	PROPERTY_HINT_NO_NODEPATH, /// < this property will not contain a NodePath, regardless of type (Array, Dictionary, List, etc.). Needed for SceneTreeDock.
	PROPERTY_HINT_GROUP_ENABLE, ///< used to make the property's group checkable. Only use for boolean types.
```
This will break data and serialization otherwise, even if `PROPERTY_HINT_NO_NODEPATH` is not exposed
